title: Spot balance
description: One row of Hyperliquid's spot clearinghouse state (REST `spotClearinghouseState` or the `spotState` stream) as the adapter parses it (src/venues/hyperliquid/account.ts, SpotBalance). `token` is the spot token's `index` field, never an array position; outcome rows (`+n`, `on`) carry none.

canonical.description: A canonical decimal string. Never a JSON number.
